task.title: Claim must be processed in MPS

step.cmd: Allocate the monies using the following formula:

ul.li: If the allocation is for one week, allocate the monies for the entire period.

If the allocation is for more than one week, allocate the monies as follows:
Determine the number of paid leave days.
Divide the gross amount received by the number of paid leave days.
Multiply the result by 5 (for each full week).
Multiply the result by the number of days for the last week (if not a full week).

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim being sent to IPOC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on fishing claims or other complex claim conditions or if the claim is already in MPS, select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Premium reduction code required on a blocked claim” or “2 premium reduction codes on claim.”
Remark line 2: Type “Process cycling claimant’s reports and send next paper claimant’s report.”

Remarks lines 3–4:
If there is one premium reduction code, type “Premium reduction code [X] from w/c [XXXX].”
If there are 2 premium reduction codes, type “Premium reduction code [X] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] and premium reduction code [X] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], allocation type [X], amount [$XXX] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] last week amount [$XXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
